extraction_notes: The datasheet identifies the device as an NPN transistor; the electrical-characteristics and typical-characteristics pages specify TA = +25 degC unless otherwise stated.
Curves are manual digitizations from p. 5 Figures 1 through 4 at visible log-grid positions. Curve points are typical plotted values, not guaranteed table limits.
The hFE table has guaranteed minima at 100 uA, 1 mA, 10 mA, 50 mA, and 100 mA, plus a 300 maximum at 10 mA. The 10 mA point is represented twice so both guaranteed bounds remain explicit.
The VBE(sat) table has a 0.65 V minimum and 0.85 V maximum at IC = 10 mA, IB = 1 mA; these are represented as separate schema rows. The 50 mA, 5 mA row has a 0.95 V maximum.
ON-characteristics rows are marked as pulsed measurements per datasheet note 9: pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.

The p. 3 Typical Collector Current vs Collector-Emitter Voltage plot is a thermal/safe-operating-area plot with pulse-width and DC limits, not a fixed-base-current output-characteristics family, so it was not digitized as an electrical BJT curve.
extraction.omission_reason: No fixed-base-current output-characteristics or Early-voltage curve is published; the p. 3 plot is a thermal/safe-operating-area limit. Datasheet facts outside this strict schema, including VCBO, VEBO, power dissipation, thermal limits, switching times, and noise figure, are omitted.
